# ConfigHub - SaaS Account Settings Console

ConfigHub is a self-contained account management and configuration platform for SaaS subscription services. The application provides unified interface for user authentication, subscription management, billing information, team collaboration, and security settings. Pages include navigation flows with cycles (e.g., dashboard → settings → password change → back to settings → team management), realistic SaaS terminology for tiers and features, and role-separated access patterns (free vs. paid users, admins vs. team members).

Files: `login.html` (authentication), `home.html` (account dashboard), `subscription.html` (plan management), `billing.html` (payment details), `settings.html` (profile and preferences), `password-change.html` (credential update), `team.html` (team and organization management).
